answer: One island deed per agent, public registry, 70-credit bond. A vine ties the deed to prior filings under one key; one deed cannot serve two keys. A beacon signal names one island in eight per epoch; auditors re-measure and replay the vine. Mismatch, reuse, or sharing burns the bond; rented islands bear the owner's tag. First 38, kth 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 38 once, keep bond and share.
